text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I decide to take a walk
around the academy.
Suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hrng?! You there! Halt! You have a
peculiar air about you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Could it be?
You're destined to stroll with
me this afternoon! Thanken
you, thanken
you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Wait a second! Could you at
least listen to what I have to
say?! It'll only
take a moment!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I have the day off today—no training or
classes—so I was thinking
about heading to
town to kick back and relax.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The thing is... during my usual morning
milk divination, it said my luck
today
would be horrendous!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But I didn't want to waste my precious day
off, so I came up with a
plan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To gather up all my luckiest items and
stuff them into my
pockets—every last one
of them!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The divination also said that spending
time with those who care for
you will improve
your luck! So please! Could you pleeease
come with me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru persistently bugs me
to accompany her, and after
finally giving
in to her request, we make our way into
town.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
First, we're stopping by the candy shop!
We can test your fortune
here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Get a piece of candy that comes with a
chance to win a prize! That'll
tell you if
you're lucky or not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I buy a piece of gum, and upon
unwrapping it—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! You won! That means your luck
today is fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Okay,
I'm next! I've got all these charms on
me, so surely I'll be able to undo the
misfortune from today's morning milk
divination!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru steels herself, then
carefully unwraps her own
piece of gum.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing written on mine, which
means I'm neither lucky nor
unlucky—so
normal luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Get with the times! It's better this way!
Anyway, hurry up! Let's go to
the next
place!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The general store—my favorite place to
look for lucky items! C'mon,
let's get
searching!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I already found something! These
are super rare daruma dolls!
Look, they all
have both of their eyes drawn on!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
They're usually drawn on when a wish has
come true, so these ones
have already
completed their mission!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'll take three, please—one to use, one to
save, and one to give away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy the rest of our walk going from
store to store. Then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No better way to wrap things up than with
a grateful prayer to the
heavens! Thank
you for another misfortune-free day!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fortune-telling... Divinations...
They really are the best. They're
always there to
motivate me—push me forward, y'know?
Well, at least ever since then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! I started believing in divinations
when I was little! I loved
running so much,
but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well... I was really bad at it.
At my school sports events, I'd always
want to be class
runner, but I didn't have the courage to
speak up—not until I had that dream.

text_block_list.name: Shiraoki
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru... Heed my words, Fukukitaru...
You are to run in your
school race. You
will run, and you will win.

text_block_list.name: Young Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really? But who are you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's how I first met the great
Shiraoki! I
followed her instructions,
running in the
race—and lo and behold, I won!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, before I start running,
I do
some kind of divination or
wish upon one
of my lucky items!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To me, all those things are a trail that
leads me to good fortune.
They're my road
to victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for them,
I'd never even make
it past the starting gate...
I'd be nothing
without them.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can't give them up—not my
lucky items, not my
divinations. I don't
want to go back to being nothing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt that Matikanefukukitaru
truly values her divinations and lucky
items. They're important to her because
they keep her
going.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reliance is fine up to a point, but it's
dangerous to become completely
dependent. I need to do something about
this and help
her before it's too late.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are we trying?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm... So you want me to try out this claw
machine, is that right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Say no more! Witness the power of my
lucky items!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Do you hear yourself?! It's
impossible for me to win without
them!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I have horrendous luck today!
Maybe the claw machine will
break down
as soon as I put my money in! That's how
bad my luck is!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... You aren't being very
reasonable right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm somehow able to convince
Matikanefukukitaru to listen to my
advice
and temporarily confiscate her lucky
items.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urk... Now I'm just a walking lump of
misfortune...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm getting a single
prize...
Not with my current luck.
I'm useless... A
sorry, hopeless blob...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well,
it's worth a shot... At least my lucky
trainer is standing by my
side... You'll do
that for me, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her pleas, I take a step back and
create distance between us.
Now alone
and itemless, she attempts the game.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
See? Nothing. But what else would
happen? It's not like I have my
lucky items
to help me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm allowed to try again? Well, okay
then... If you say so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru plays round after
round, until finally—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flop!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait... I won?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I did it! I won a prize!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... So what you're saying is...
If I don't
have my lucky items with
me, all I need to
do is make my own luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Phew... I feel like a huge weight has been lifted—literally. It's good knowing I don't have to carry all that stuff around with me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yep, I get it now! You're right.
I was being
too scared for my own
good. I'll try to cut
down on my lucky items.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But wow... Today sure was a super lucky
day after all! This is the start
of a new
chapter for me—I know it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This prize that I so painstakingly won
will
serve to commemorate this
wonderful
occasion! It will be my newest lucky item!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Or well...
I guess I shouldn't add even more
to my collection. Ehehe...
I'll just give this
to one of the good kids in the
neighborhood or something.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to make do with the stuff
I've already got! As long as
you're with me,
that's more than enough for me! It
wouldn't hurt to do a bit of decluttering
after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a smile on her face, she gives a
satisfied nod. Hopefully, this
change of
heart is a step in the right direction.
